title: Delete Node in a Linked List
description: Delete a given node in a singly linked list. You are not given access to the head, only the node to be deleted.

steps.note: Copy the value of the next node (5) into the current node (4). The list effectively becomes [4, 5, 5, 9].
Skip the next node by updating the current node's next pointer to point to the node after next. The list becomes [4, 5, 9].
